description: House branch guard: denies the enumerable ways to disable or move the git-hook floor that enforces a repo's branch policy, and commits on a protected branch, in repos that opt in via house.json. Arms the floor (core.hooksPath) at session start, logs InstructionsLoaded events, the rule-load positive control `house doctor` reads, and injects the orchestration defaults (roster, model tier, briefs, verification) at session start.
